name: spring-element
title: Spring
description: A small round label that can be dragged anywhere; a drawn coil stretches between it and its resting spot, and letting go lets the spring pull it back with a wobble.
use: A playful page wants one draggable token that visibly remembers where it belongs.
avoid: Drag needs a pointer, so there is no keyboard way to move the chip, and a long pull can run it off a small container.
a11y: Only pointer drag moves the chip and it is not focusable, so keyboard users cannot use it at all. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A pale circular chip reading "Drag" sits on a black stage. Pulled away, it trails a thin grey wire of even loops back to an otherwise empty anchor point, the coil lengthening as the gap grows.
behaves: Dragging moves the chip with the pointer and redraws the coil every frame, thinning it as it stretches. Releasing sends the chip back to its anchor on a spring that overshoots once before settling, and with reduced motion it jumps straight home.
customise: Spring stiffness and damping, coil count, amplitude and curve ratios go on the provider; the dragged chip and its text are children you supply.
weight: moderate: Spring values rebuild the SVG coil path on every frame while dragging; idle afterwards.
issues: Frames 3 and 4 pull the chip to the crop edge and clip it, so the scene's extremes are cut off.
The spring is drawn in a fixed full-viewport layer, so it will paint over the rest of the page.
polishWhy: Convincing coil geometry and a lively snap-back, though the demo runs the chip out of the crop.
